currency.basis: Operating bank per CBR registry and ACRA 2026; the live site asset is the current presentation.

identity.basis: The official sngb.ru site (Сургутнефтегазбанк, fullTitle in metadata) serves logo.svg as its header brand asset; the emblem is the bank's rhombus mark used with the СНГБ wordmark.

assessment.independenceRationale: Official site asset, CBR registry and an independent rating-agency publication are separate sources; the CSS binding of the asset to the header was verified in the site's own stylesheet.
uncertainties: Catalog suitability of the full lockup requires dropping the СНГБ wordmark and slogan; only the standalone rhombus emblem is proposed.

variant.basis: The primary site-wide header variant: blue rhombus with yellow lens beside the СНГБ wordmark; emblem colors #004282/#FDB913 as drawn in the official asset.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Rhombus geometry, yellow lens shape and the transparent gap between lens and rhombus survive optimization and rendering on both themes; no lost detail or color shift. The transparent gap shows the theme background exactly as the source structure defines.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: The emblem is a wide (about 2:1) mark; it fills its viewBox with balanced margins, stays complete and legible at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes, with the lens clearly visible.
candidate.rationale: First addition for an existing record without an icon. The operating bank's official header SVG is a genuine original vector; the standalone rhombus emblem was selected losslessly (two verbatim original paths, wordmark and slogan removed for catalog suitability) and optimized with SVGO.
candidate.role: Standalone brand emblem (blue rhombus with yellow lens) extracted from the official header lockup; the СНГБ wordmark and the slogan line are excluded per catalog suitability.
transforms: Lossless selection of the first two original paths (#FDB913 lens, #004282 rhombus) from the fetched lockup; wordmark/slogan paths dropped; no geometry, color or alpha edits (working.svg, 863 bytes).

SVGO 4.1.0 with repository config svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e), multipass: 863 -> 750 bytes; selected (optimized.svg sha256 2939240f5e37f365097063c0cc4679c14bd6e70ce102c2a1fc4de7b85ccd730e); pixel comparison of working versus optimized renders showed no difference (max-diff bbox none); viewport preserved.
No placement transform needed: the emblem fills its 36.01x18.1 viewBox; whole-emblem geometry untouched.
candidate.variant: Original vector emblem on a transparent field; no circular catalog backing applied because the mark is a suitable transparent standalone symbol whose rhombus contour and internal transparent lens gap are preserved.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: First addition: the frozen base has no icon.svg for this bank (iconHash null); the visible difference is absent-to-real-icon.

proposals.reason: Original vector found on the operating bank's official site: https://www.sngb.ru/local/templates/sngb/assets/cd91b177/img/logo.svg, an Illustrator-exported header lockup (blue rhombus emblem with yellow lens + СНГБ wordmark + slogan). The standalone emblem is losslessly separable (2 of 6 top-level paths). The bank is active (CBR registry reg. 588, ACRA Feb-2026), so the current site asset is the relevant current presentation.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Genuine original vector served by the operating bank's official site; first addition for a record without an icon. The standalone rhombus emblem is losslessly separable from the wordmark/slogan for the catalog.

sources.observation: Official site header binds the logo.svg asset via production widgets CSS (.wp-widget-header .logo); the SVG (107568 bytes, Illustrator-exported) contains the rhombus emblem (fill #004282, lens #FDB913), the СНГБ lettering and the slogan line as separate top-level paths.

Bank of Russia registry and credit-organization list (checked 2026-10-01 by the research pass, reg. 588, general license 05.09.2016) confirm Сургутнефтегазбанк (СНГБ) is operating; current site branding is the relevant period.
ACRA February 2026 press release confirms ongoing operations of СНГБ, corroborating currency of the current logo.
